nodes.summary: The critical inverse temperature `β_c(d) = inf {β ≥ 0 | m*(β) > 0}` (equal to `0` if the set is empty, by the convention `sInf ∅ = 0`).
nodes.title: Critical inverse temperature from spontaneous magnetization

nodes.summary: The FK critical point satisfies `p_c(d, q) < 1` for `d ≥ 2` and `q ≥ 1` (Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, Theorem 5.5).
nodes.title: FK critical point is less than one for $d \ge 2$, $q \ge 1$

nodes.summary: The spin at a site is integrable for every finite measure.
nodes.title: Integrability of the spin at a site under finite measures

nodes.summary: The public Ising critical inverse temperature `Ising.betaC d` in dimension `d ≥ 2` is `-(1/2) log (1 - p_c(d, 2))`, the image of the FK critical point. This is the form usable with `ising_sharp_phase_transition`, whose `β_c` is `Ising.betaC d`.
nodes.title: Inf-based $\beta_c$ equals $-\tfrac{1}{2}\log(1 - p_c)$ for $d \ge 2$

nodes.summary: Bridge between the two critical-point definitions: the public `Ising.betaC d = sInf {β ≥ 0 | m*(β) > 0}` equals the sup-based `IsingFK.betaC (magnetization d) = sSup {β > 0 | m*(β) = 0}` in dimension `d ≥ 2`. The `β = 0` case is not covered by the phase-transition statement (which only speaks about `β > 0`), so it is settled separately: `φ_0({0}) = tanh 0 * … = 0 < 1`, hence the plus-state two-point function at…
nodes.title: Inf-based and sup-based Ising critical points agree for $d \ge 2$

nodes.summary: The sup-based critical inverse temperature `IsingFK.betaC (magnetization d)` in dimension `d ≥ 2` is `-(1/2) log (1 - p_c(d, 2))`, the image of the FK critical point. This is the supremum of the zero-magnetization inverse temperatures, not yet the public `Ising.betaC d` (see `ising_betaC_eq_sup_betaC_of_two_le` for the bridge).
nodes.title: Sup-based $\beta_c$ equals $-\tfrac{1}{2}\log(1 - p_c)$ for $d \ge 2$

nodes.summary: Existence of the Ising phase transition in dimension `d ≥ 2`: there is `β_c > 0` such that the spontaneous magnetization vanishes for `0 < β < β_c` and is positive for `β > β_c` (Peierls, 1936; Griffiths, Phys. Rev. 136 (1964); Duminil-Copin, *Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice*, 2017). The statement says nothing about `β = β_c`.
nodes.title: Existence of the Ising phase transition

nodes.summary: The spontaneous magnetization `m*(β) = ⟨σ_0⟩⁺_β`: the expected spin at the origin under the zero-field plus state.
nodes.title: Spontaneous magnetization of the Ising model

nodes.summary: The spin at a site is a measurable function of the configuration.
nodes.title: Measurability of the spin at a site

nodes.summary: The set of inverse temperatures `β ≥ 0` at which the spontaneous magnetization is positive.
nodes.title: Inverse temperatures with positive spontaneous magnetization

nodes.summary: The two-dimensional Ising model has positive spontaneous magnetization at some inverse temperature (Peierls, *On Ising's model of ferromagnetism*, 1936; Griffiths, Phys. Rev. 136 (1964)).
nodes.title: Peierls' theorem

nodes.summary: The spin at `x` as a bounded continuous real function on the configuration space.
nodes.title: Spin at a site as a bounded continuous function

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
